faq.question: Who can advise on medical cost support?
faq.answer: 129 is the Health and Welfare Counseling Center for welfare and medical cost support programs. Eligibility and application procedures vary. For an urgent medical emergency, call 119 first.

faq.question: Who can advise on expressway emergency towing?
faq.answer: Call 1588-2504 and confirm eligibility and towing limits. On Korea Expressway Corporation roads, emergency towing supports eligible vehicles to the nearest safety area, not onward transport to a repair shop.

faq.question: Espionage or counterintelligence reporting numbers?
faq.answer: You can report to 111 (NIS) and 113 (police counterintelligence).

emergency.title: Who to call first in an emergency
emergency.summary: Emergency response, welfare support, infectious disease advice, and suicide prevention counseling have different purposes.

sections.heading: Decide if life is at risk
paragraphs: For urgent fire, rescue, or medical emergencies, call 119 from a safe place and give your location, situation, and the number of people needing help.
For urgent crime or threats to your safety, call 112. Text reporting is available if speaking is difficult.

sections.heading: Questions about medical cost support
paragraphs: 129 is the Health and Welfare Counseling Center for welfare and medical cost support programs.
Ask about eligibility and application procedures. 129 is not an emergency medical dispatch service; for urgent rescue or medical care, call 119 first.

sections.heading: Infectious disease advice
paragraphs: 1339 is the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency call center for infectious disease information, prevention, vaccination, and reporting. For urgent medical response, call 119.

sections.heading: Suicide prevention support
paragraphs: 109 provides suicide prevention counseling 24 hours a day. If someone's life or physical safety is in immediate danger, call 119 or 112 first.

car-accident.title: Traffic accidents and car breakdowns: call order
car-accident.summary: Emergency response, expressway towing limits, insurance coverage, and government compensation guidance.

sections.heading: Request the right emergency response
paragraphs: For injuries or rescue, call 119 and follow the responder's instructions.
For a police emergency, call 112 and give the accident location and current dangers. Accident certificates and routine inquiries use separate police procedures.
bullets: Your insurer — reporting and assistance within policy coverage

sections.heading: Check expressway towing eligibility
paragraphs: From a safe place, contact 1588-2504 with your road location and vehicle situation. Confirm eligibility and towing limits.

On Korea Expressway Corporation roads, emergency towing supports eligible vehicles at risk of secondary accidents to the nearest safety area. Further transport to a repair shop is not necessarily free; confirm charges before agreeing.

sections.heading: Uninsured or hit-and-run opponent
paragraphs: For government compensation program inquiries, call the Automobile Compensation Promotion Institute at 1544-0049 and select 1. Ask about statutory eligibility and required documents for hit-and-run, uninsured vehicle, and other covered injury cases. Not every accident or property loss qualifies.

housing.title: Jeonse, moving, noise, and housing issues
housing.summary: Rental deposit guarantees, postal forwarding, neighbor noise support, and urgent household hazards.

sections.heading: Rental deposit guarantee inquiries
paragraphs: 1566-9009 is HUG's integrated call center for rental deposit return guarantees, rental loans, and Housing and Urban Fund products.
Check a guarantee's eligibility and coverage. This is not the dedicated rental fraud victim support channel.

sections.heading: Forward mail after moving
paragraphs: Ask the postal customer center at 1588-1300 about mail forwarding conditions, duration, and fees. Bank, card, insurance, and other registered addresses must be updated separately.

sections.heading: Neighbor noise and urgent hazards
paragraphs: 1661-2642 is the Neighbor Noise Center for apartment noise counseling and on-site support. Ask about eligibility and procedures; binding mediation or a resolved dispute is not guaranteed.
For urgent fire, rescue, or other immediate danger, call 119. For non-emergency gas service matters, contact the gas supplier responsible for your area.

legal-finance.title: Phishing, consumer disputes, and legal counseling
legal-finance.summary: Financial phishing reporting, consumer advice, legal aid eligibility, and health insurance inquiries.

sections.heading: If you suspect voice phishing
paragraphs: End a suspected phishing call, then contact 1394 for advice or integrated reporting. For immediate crime or threats to your safety, call 112.
1332 is the Financial Supervisory Service counseling line for financial products and harm from illegal financial activity.

sections.heading: Refunds and contract disputes
paragraphs: 1372 provides consumer counseling on transactions, contracts, and consumer harm. Prepare contracts, payment records, and other relevant documents.

sections.heading: Legal counseling and health insurance
paragraphs: 132 is the Korea Legal Aid Corporation number for legal counseling and litigation support eligibility. Calling charges are paid by the caller.

1577-1000 is the National Health Insurance Service number for premiums, benefits, and reimbursement, including questions about the out-of-pocket ceiling. Ask about eligibility and procedures; refunds are not guaranteed.

civil-admin.title: Civil complaints: 110 and regional 120
civil-admin.summary: National government inquiry guidance and regional call centers with their own coverage and hours.

sections.heading: 110 vs 0XX-120
paragraphs: 110 provides free government inquiry counseling 24 hours every day. Ask which office handles your issue.
For regional inquiries, use the relevant published number, such as Seoul 02-120 or Gyeonggi 031-120. Regional coverage, hours, and calling fees vary; not every area has an equivalent 120 service.

sections.heading: Gov24 online service help
paragraphs: 1588-2188 is the Gov24 customer center for help using online government services and certificate issuance. Check the official service page for the documents and process relevant to your request.

family-welfare.title: Family, welfare, youth, and women’s emergency support
family-welfare.summary: School violence, domestic violence, illegal filming, youth counseling, and support numbers for families.

sections.heading: School violence and domestic violence
paragraphs: Report school violence by calling 117 or texting #0117. For immediate danger, call 112.
1366 provides emergency counseling and support referrals for violence against women, 24 hours every day. Calls are charged.

sections.heading: Illegal filming and digital sex crimes
paragraphs: 02-735-8994 is the central digital sex crime victim support center. Ask about victim counseling, content removal assistance, and referrals. Hours: weekdays 08:00–22:00; weekends and public holidays 09:00–18:00.

about.seoDescription: WhatNumber? is a free web service that organizes public hotlines you need in urgent and daily situations.
about.title: Numbers you did not know you needed
about.lead: WhatNumber? is a free web service that lists public hotlines Koreans actually need in urgent and daily life, organized by situation.
about.problemP1Before: Many know 119 and 112, but numbers like 129 for welfare support, 1588-2504 for expressway towing guidance, or 1566-9009 for rental deposit guarantees—
about.problemP1Strong: useful numbers with different service scopes
about.problemP1After: — rarely show up in a quick search. In a rush there is no time to Google; hopping across government sites is hard.
about.problemP2: WhatNumber? gathers these in one place with situation filters, search, and favorites so you can find and dial quickly on mobile.
about.selectionP1: We prioritize public agency and call-center numbers with real-world demand—emergency, traffic, housing, legal, family, employment, civil affairs. Each entry adds when to call, based on official agency guidance.
about.selectionP2: Numbers and rules change. For major decisions (jeonse, legal action), always confirm with the official agency.
about.contentP1After: explain emergency response, phishing reports, welfare support, and other service choices. Each number detail describes the hotline's purpose.

privacy.seoDescription: How WhatNumber? handles personal data and retention.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: WhatNumber? (“the Service”) values your privacy and complies with applicable law. This policy applies from June 10, 2026.

collect.heading: 1. Information we collect
collect.intro: The Service (web and mobile app) works without sign-up. We do not long-term store on servers personally identifying information such as name, email, or phone number.

items.title: Favorites
items.body: Selected number IDs are stored only on your device. Web uses browser localStorage; the mobile app uses AsyncStorage. They are not sent to our server.

items.title: Theme
items.body: Light/dark mode choice is stored in local device storage.

items.title: Nearby ERs (mobile)
items.body: Location is requested only when you start a nearby ER search. Approximate coordinates are sent to our server solely to query public APIs such as NEMC. We do not store location history or collect location in the background.

items.title: Maps (mobile)
items.body: ER maps use Naver Map SDK. Naver Cloud Platform map services may handle network requests for map tiles and display.

items.title: Number requests and feedback
items.body: What you submit on web/app passes through our server to operator email via Resend, processed only as needed for the request—not stored in a member database.

items.title: Usage analytics (web)
items.body: Vercel Analytics may collect anonymized visit stats (country, device type, referrer, etc.).

items.title: App updates (mobile)
items.body: Expo EAS Update may download JavaScript bundles for improvements. No personally identifying information is collected in that process.

ads.heading: 2. Advertising (Google AdSense · AdMob)
ads.body: The web may show ads via Google AdSense; the mobile app via Google AdMob. Mobile banners request non-personalized ads without ATT tracking. On the web, Google and partners may use cookies and ad IDs for interest-based ads and measurement. Mobile ads may appear as bottom banners; Android may use the AD_ID permission.

links.before: Turn off personalized ads in Google ad settings:
links.label: google.com/settings/ads

cookies.heading: 3. Cookies
cookies.body: The web and third parties (e.g. Google) may use cookies and similar technologies for features, analytics, and ads. You can refuse or delete cookies in browser settings, but some features may be limited.

retention.heading: 4. Retention and deletion
retention.body: Favorites and theme on device remain until you clear app/browser data or reset them. Operators cannot access that data. ER lookup coordinates are not kept on the server after the request.

rights.heading: 5. Your rights
rights.body: Clear favorites and theme in the Service or by deleting device/browser data anytime. For AdSense, Analytics, and AdMob, see Google policy pages. Revoke location permission in device settings anytime.

changes.heading: 6. Policy changes
changes.body: We will post changes on this page and may add in-service notice for important updates.
